## Checklist

- [ ] `just ci` passes locally (fmt check, clippy `-D warnings --all-features`, build, test)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change (protocol changes include compatibility tests)
- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented (README / docs / USER_GUIDE as applicable)
- [ ] UI changes are keyboard-reachable and checked in light, dark, high-contrast, and reduced-motion modes
- [ ] UI symbols use the bundled Phosphor icons (no raw Unicode glyphs — `glyph_guard` enforces this)
- [ ] No package publication or update installation is triggered implicitly
